items.lede: Meta says it may push the implementation of its new business terms past November 20th as it faces backlash from publishers over concerns about AI training. In a post on X, Meta communications head Andy Stone said the company does "not plan to make policy changes without a full consultation with industry groups and leaders." […]
items.title: Meta says it’ll probably delay its controversial new business terms again

items.lede: The company says it won't make "policy changes" until it consults with publishers.
items.title: Meta weighs delaying 'alarming' new business terms as backlash grows
